summary: Phase 3.2 (Authorization/RBAC) verified end-to-end on the standalone NestJS project at /app/tema-middleware. Build + lint clean; 89/89 unit tests pass; 42/42 e2e tests pass across 6 suites (including new authorization.service.spec.ts and authorization.e2e-spec.ts). OpenAPI still emits exactly 5 paths (/health, /ready, /version, /health/integrations, /me) with no /__authz and no business paths - confirming the test-only controller is scoped to the e2e module. Runtime regression on port 8130 (NODE_ENV=production, auth off): /health UP, /ready READY, /version returns service metadata, /health/integrations shows sql-server & sage-x3 DISABLED, /me returns {authenticated:false}, unknown route returns {code:NOT_FOUND, requestId:<uuid>} with matching x-correlation-id, and a client-supplied x-correlation-id header is echoed verbatim. Prod safety on port 8131 (NODE_ENV=production AUTH_ENABLED=true AUTH_PROVIDER=dev) correctly refuses to start with the exact message 'AUTH_PROVIDER=dev cannot be enabled in production; use AUTH_PROVIDER=oidc'. The AND/OR authz rule (within-type OR, across-type AND), fail-closed behavior (empty/unknown roles/permissions, missing user->401, @Public bypass), and no-leakage on 403 (no token/subject/claims/stack) are all covered and passing in the e2e suite.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthorizationModule ordering in app.module.ts correctly places AuthModule before AuthorizationModule so authN runs before authZ - good.
Fail-closed logic in authorization.service verified via unit tests (empty/unknown roles/permissions never grant).
Test-only /__authz controller lives only in test/authorization.e2e-spec.ts and is not part of AppModule - confirmed by openapi.json still showing 5 paths only.

403 responses contain code/message/requestId only - no token, subject, claims, or stack leaked (validated by e2e assertions and by inspecting the log stream: response bodies are 133 bytes with correlationId).
Correlation propagation working: server-generated requestId matches x-correlation-id header; client-supplied header is echoed as-is.
test_credentials: None - dev HS256 tokens are minted inline within the e2e spec using a throwaway secret.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone NestJS project at /app/tema-middleware (NOT the pod's FastAPI/React stack). Use `yarn build`, `yarn lint`, `yarn test`, `yarn test:e2e`, `yarn openapi:generate` directly. For manual runtime checks, start with `NODE_ENV=production TEMA_PORT=8130 node dist/main.js &` and always `pkill -f dist/main.js` afterwards. All 89 unit + 42 e2e tests passing on this iteration; OpenAPI has exactly 5 paths.
